caption:
Looking for a rishta without intrusive calls or unverified spam? Rishta Connect brings a calm approach to family matchmaking.

Every profile submitted to Rishta Connect goes through human moderation to help maintain relevant and genuine connections. Along with human review, match cards show a 36-point Guna Milan score to help families evaluate compatibility at a glance.

Please note: Kundali calculations and Guna Milan scores are indicative; consult your pandit.

Explore Rishta Connect at rishtapatra.com
